label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~88) after a rewarded trial, toward S1 / a1
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew = 0 at GO, but prev_reward = 1 covers 100% of the mass), and only in the last ~15 trials of an episode (none before trial 78; 93% of mass in trials 90-99; it lines up with low value-head output). Within that, it prefers the S1 / a1 side: the previous trial reached S1 (including a2 -> S1 rare-rewarded, which gives the top activations) or the agent is choosing a1 now (model_act is the agent own GO choice, so it is observed/computed, not future). Magnitude ramps with episode position and goes up over consecutive rewarded trials in a window. Silent at D1 and D2, after unrewarded trials, and early in episodes. Dev: base (GO & prev_reward & ep_trial>=88) has F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.97; adding prev_state==1 gets F1 0.75; the recorded S1-or-a1 version gets F1 0.79, mass recall 0.91. It reads as an episode-end timer gated by a rewarded S1/a1 history, so it is only partially explained. No future variables are used.
